versions.changelog:
**Major update: Improved self-review flow, adds automatic mistake tracking, and changes review command.**

- Replaces per-file reviewing with a single `review-work` command using `--context` and, if relevant, `--skill`.
- Reviewer now checks against skill requirements (if skill used) and past mistakes (via auto-included LESSONS.md).
- Automatic logging of critical/major issues to LESSONS.md for future mistake checking.
- Do not prompt user for review arguments; auto-detect output path and skill used.
- Adjusted rules and workflow to support the new command signature and learning process.

Initial release of claude-review — a self-review quality gate using Claude CLI.

- Enables automated quality checks by running `review-work` on all files created or modified during a task.
- Identifies files and task descriptions automatically; user input for those is not required.
- Detects and addresses critical and major issues with up to three iterative review cycles before delivering work.
- Ensures every deliverable passes an independent Claude-based code review before completion.
- Requires Claude CLI installation and configuration.
